traits.name: Hungersense
traits.text: Hungersense allows the gimmerling to sense creatures that require food to live.

traits.name: Treacherous Aura
traits.text: (aura, primal, transmutation); 15 feet. Tangled roots, jagged divots, sharp rocks and other hazards appear on surfaces in the aura, creating difficult terrain.

traits.name: Trip Up
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A creature critically fails a melee attack to hit the gimmerling or moves into a space within the gimmerling's treacherous aura. Effect The triggering creature must attempt a DC 32 Reflex save. Critical Success The target is unaffected. Success The target is flat-footed until the start of its next turn. Failure The target takes 2d10 (2d10) bludgeoning damage and is flat-footed until the start of its next turn. Critical Failure As failure, and the target is knocked prone.

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.text: ⬻ (concentrate, polymorph, primal, transmutation); The gimmerling changes into its natural form or that of any humanoid. In humanoid form, it loses its treacherous aura, and its equipment appears to be trinkets or toys. As a humanoid that lacks claws or fangs, it loses the matching Strike. If it loses its claw Strike, it gains a fist Strike that is identical except that it deals bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Disarm
traits.text: ⬺ Requirements The gimmerling's last action was a success with a Strike that has Disarm in its damage entry. Effect The gimmerling knocks a held or carried weapon to the ground in the target's space.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: The gimmerling deals 2d6 (2d6) extra precision damage to flat-footed creatures.

traits.name: Trickster's Step
traits.text: The gimmerling ignores difficult terrain and doesn't trigger traps with its movement.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ claw +26 (agile, finesse); Damage 2d8+7 (2d8+7) slashing plus Disarm

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ hand crossbow +28 (range increment 60 feet, reload 1); Damage 2d6+3 (2d6+3) piercing plus 2d6 (2d6) poison
